title: PWNR Gang
description: Vanilla with a bit of spice!
body:
Vanilla with a bit of spice! For anyone wanting a good looking minecraft without any extra blocks or massive game mechanics 

Adds a lot of optimization mods like lithium and sodium to increase FPS.
Adds Distant Horizons which changes the look of minecraft
Some shaders and resource packs for some 3d block effects
Includes generation mods like terralith for different biomes and generation but with vanilla blocks
